name: storage
description: Object storage for documents, files, queues, and tables. AI Foundry projects require containers + files + queues + tables.

roleAssignments.note: Needed when AI Services system identity manages storage

defaultConfig.note: AI Foundry requires all four service types. For simple blob-only scenarios, omit files/queues/tables.

integration.authNote: Use DefaultAzureCredential with Storage Blob Data Contributor role. No connection strings or access keys needed.

bicepWiring.namingConstraints: Storage account names: 3-24 chars, lowercase letters and numbers only. Use: toLower(replace('st${resourceToken}', '-', ''))

sdkInitPattern.python:
from azure.storage.blob.aio import BlobServiceClient
from azure.identity.aio import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
blob_client = BlobServiceClient(
    account_url=os.environ['AZURE_STORAGE_BLOB_ENDPOINT'],
    credential=credential
)
container = blob_client.get_container_client('documents')

healthCheck.description: Get account info to validate connectivity and permissions
